summary: Post ajv override fix validation. Verified /app/frontend/package.json has overrides.ajv=^8.12.0. /app/frontend/build/index.html exists and app loads via preview URL (dev-server hot reload also serves it). Ran all previously-verified regressions: sidebar navigation across all 10 pages, Accounts/Sites/Categories/Rules Add modals open with save buttons, Transaction drawer opens on row click and Save persists (closes drawer, no drawer-error), Transaction filters narrow rows (20 -> 19 with 'Classified' status), Reports month-close-toggle flips 'Close month' <-> 'Reopen month' and hydrates from /api/reports/summary (closed key present). Backup download and Restore submit buttons rendered. Zero pageerror or console errors captured. Backend pytest suite (9 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_site_expense.py) passes 100%. Smoke tested 10 backend GET endpoints — all 200; /api/reports/summary?month=2026-08 includes 'closed' key.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is single-line minified-style formatting (long chained lines). Not a defect but hurts readability; consider prettier-format.
overrides added at top-level of package.json — good; note npm v8+ honours overrides while yarn 1 honours resolutions. Both are now specified so cross-package-manager installs are safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth; single-user local app. Preview URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Backend at /api/*. All add/save testids for masters use template literals `${type}-add-button` and `${type}-save-button`. Transaction rows use testid `txn-row-{id}`. Backend tests reside in /app/backend/tests/test_site_expense.py.
